title: A few dozen UAP reports are real, some known from inside government

plain: Eric Hazeline, presented on a podcast as a former director of the National Security Agency, America's electronic spying agency, says that out of the many thousands of reports of UAP, the government's term for unidentified objects in the sky, a few dozen are real. He says he has inside knowledge of some of them from his time in government, and ties the view to a book called The New Science of UFOs, citing a colleague named Chris Gilbert. If true, a top intelligence insider is vouching that some cases cannot be explained away.
